page.title: About Us - Global Composable Leader
page.body: Sitecore empowers brands with AI-orchestrated digital experiences, real-time customer data integration, and enterprise-grade headless content operations across web, mobile, and omnichannel endpoints.

page.body: Reach out to our round-the-clock Sitecore XM Cloud solutions architecture team, certified partner network, and technical support consultants worldwide.

page.title: AI Ingestion Engine
page.body: High-throughput batch ingestion pipeline transforming legacy XML feeds and unstructured documents into native Sitecore content items with schema validation and metadata enrichment.

page.title: Personalization and Edge Analytics
page.body: Leverage edge computing and customer data platform signals to dynamically tailor page variations, multivariate tests, and recommendation widgets with sub-second response times.
